To accommodate its workforce, Allstate is implementing a new strategy where 25% of its 54,000 corporate employees will utilize coworking spaces for meetings and team-building, a less strict approach compared to companies like Amazon and Dell. This "testing and learning" phase allows the insurance giant to manage in-person gatherings in cities where a full office lease isn't necessary.

title: Equinix is closing its bare metal IaaS platform
summary: Equinix announced it will discontinue its bare-metal infrastructure-as-a-service (IaaS) platform, Equinix Metal, by June 2026. The decision comes due to the platform representing only 1.25% of the company's revenue and intense competition from hyperscalers like AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud. Equinix will continue to prioritize performance, security, and stability features until the sunset date and assist customers with transitioning to alternative solutions.

title: Mattel Bets Big On Its IP
summary: Mattel Inc. is shifting its strategy to heavily capitalize on its intellectual property by expanding into movies, TV shows, and theme parks. This move, spearheaded by CEO Ynon Kreiz, aims to leverage iconic brands like Barbie and Hot Wheels beyond traditional toy sales, creating new revenue streams and engaging adult fans. The strategy appears to be paying off, with significant net income growth and positive analyst outlooks, despite the company's stock price being lower than its all-time high.

title: OneAscent Large Cap Core ETF Holdings
summary: The OneAscent Large Cap Core ETF (OALC), established in 2021, focuses on large-cap equity, managing $231.6 million in assets across 206 holdings. Its portfolio is actively managed, screened for value-based philosophy, and aims for capital appreciation. Key holdings include NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Amazon.

title: Costco Membership Fees Are What Makes It Profitable
summary: Costco's membership fees, while only 2% of annual revenue, are crucial to its profitability because they contribute 66% of the retailer's bottom line due to their presumed zero cost. The company recently raised its membership fees for the first time in seven years, impacting 52 million members. This move significantly boosts Costco's net income, which rose 17% to $7.37 billion in the last fiscal year.

title: Allstate Thinks Outside the Cubicle With Flexible Workspaces
summary: Allstate is embracing flexible workspaces, moving beyond traditional offices to a hybrid model that includes coworking spaces and redesigned leased offices. This shift aims to reduce real estate costs and offer employees more collaborative and focused environments, acknowledging that the pandemic has permanently changed white-collar work. The company is using platforms like LiquidSpace for on-demand offices, adapting to the needs of a remote-first workforce while still providing opportunities for in-person interaction.

title: Qurate’s new strategy banks on streaming, social media platforms
summary: Qurate Retail Group, parent company of QVC and HSN, is rebranding to QVC Group and shifting its focus to live social shopping across streaming and social media platforms. The company aims to generate $1.5 billion in revenue from these new channels within three years, despite recent struggles with falling sales and Nasdaq compliance issues. This strategic pivot includes leadership changes and a push to tailor content for platforms like TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, Netflix, and Hulu.

title: $12.5M financing completed for iconic Culver Theater in California
summary: JLL Capital Markets has successfully arranged $12.5 million in senior financing for the Culver Theater in Culver City, California. The financing for the 41,341-square-foot movie theater and production studio was secured for Oliver McMillan LLC through Zions Capital Markets. This prime real estate asset, located in a thriving hub for media and technology, is 100% occupied and benefits from a long-term lease with a global e-commerce giant.

title: Wall Street’s hottest stock, Palantir, only employs 3,892 people
summary: Palantir (PLTR) has become the S&P 500's best-performing stock, reaching a $150 billion market capitalization despite having fewer than 4,000 employees. The company's shares surged after strong third-quarter earnings, driven by demand for its AI platform, and a planned move to Nasdaq. This remarkable valuation highlights a growing trend in AI-adjacent stocks where market cap per employee is a significant metric.

title: For Utilities Stocks, Wait and Watch When It Comes to Nuclear Plant Deals
summary: The article discusses the limited benefits of nuclear power plant deals for utility stocks, despite the growing demand for electricity from the AI industry and data centers. While Vistra VE is identified as a utility poised to gain significantly from such partnerships, Morningstar strategist Travis Miller cautions that investing in other utilities based on these deals may be premature due to regulatory risks and already high stock valuations.

title: Akamai Extends Microsegmentation to Amazon Web Services; Enhances ZTNA for Optimal Application Performance
summary: Akamai Technologies announced the extension of its microsegmentation solution, Akamai Guardicore Segmentation, to support agentless enforcement for cloud native resources in Amazon Web Services (AWS). This enhancement aims to provide better visibility and security controls for cloud environments. Additionally, Akamai updated its Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) product, Akamai Enterprise Application Access, to improve application performance and user experience, leveraging Akamai Connected Cloud's edge delivery capabilities.

title: BAFE Top Holdings List & Exposure (Brown Advisory Flexible Equity ETF)
summary: This article details the top holdings and exposure of the Brown Advisory Flexible Equity ETF (BAFE). It highlights that the ETF's top 25 holdings, including Microsoft, Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing, and Amazon.com, constitute 76.53% of its total fund. The report also breaks down BAFE's geographic, currency, sector, and industry exposures, showing a dominant allocation to the United States and the Technology sector.

title: Walmart raises guidance after another strong earnings report ahead of the holiday season
summary: Walmart continues its strong performance, surpassing Wall Street expectations in its fiscal third-quarter earnings with sales reaching $169.59 billion and adjusted EPS of $0.58. The retailer observed increased foot traffic and higher average ticket sales, leading to a 5.3% jump in Walmart US same-store sales. Building on this momentum, Walmart has raised its fiscal year 2025 guidance for the third time, anticipating net sales growth between 4.8% and 5.1% due to ongoing consumer focus on value and the success of its e-commerce and alternative revenue streams.

title: SpotlightAI’s Rise: A Turning Point for Safe Pro Group or a Bubble Waiting to Burst?
summary: This article examines the recent surge in Safe Pro Group Inc. (SPAI) stock, driven by its acquisition of a competitor and the development of SpotlightAI™ for demining. Despite the technological advancements and positive market narrative, the company's financial performance shows significant losses, raising questions about its valuation and long-term sustainability. The article explores whether the current investor enthusiasm is for a breakthrough innovation or a potential financial bubble.

title: Who’s Winning the Beauty Retailer Race for Gen Z?
summary: The article explores the intensifying competition among beauty retailers like Sephora, Ulta Beauty, Target, and Amazon for the loyalty of Gen Z consumers, who are the only cohort with growing beauty spend in units. It highlights Sephora's lead in market share according to Piper Sandler, the diversified shopping habits of Gen Z prioritizing value and product over brand, and the rising influence of platforms like TikTok Shop and Amazon as discovery channels. The piece also delves into how brands like Bubble and Benefit Cosmetics are adapting their strategies across different retail environments to capture this demographic.

title: Kurv Investment Management Completes Reorganization of Yield Premium Suite to Proprietary Trust
summary: Kurv Investment Management has successfully reorganized its Yield Premium Suite ETFs into the Kurv ETF Trust, a move aimed at enhancing operational control and efficiency. This transition consolidates all ETFs under one trust, including those tracking major tech companies like Amazon, Apple, and Microsoft. The reorganization does not alter the funds' names, investment objectives, strategies, risks, or expense ratios, ensuring continuity for investors.

title: Global X NASDAQ 100 Covered Call ETF Holdings
summary: This article details the holdings of the Global X NASDAQ 100 Covered Call ETF (QYLD), created by Global X on December 12, 2013. The ETF focuses on large-cap equity, has $8,076.34 million in AUM, and holds 102 stocks, tracking the Nasdaq 100 by selling call options. The top holdings include NVIDIA Corp, Apple Inc, and Microsoft Corp, with a comprehensive list of holdings and recent changes provided.

title: Americans Spend More on Streaming Services Than Retirement
summary: A new study by First Merchants Bank reveals that Americans, particularly Millennials and Gen Xers, prioritize spending on short-term services like streaming and food delivery over long-term financial goals such as retirement savings. The study indicates that 47% of respondents prioritize streaming, while only 26% prioritize retirement savings, leading to overspending for many due to economic challenges. Financial assistance tools and budgeting strategies are suggested to help individuals balance immediate enjoyment with future investments.

title: Walmart hits new highs and Target dives after earnings as rivals diverge even more
summary: Walmart (WMT) and Target (TGT) earnings reports show a significant divergence in performance, with Walmart reaching new highs while Target's stock tumbled. Walmart attributed its success to gaining upper-income shoppers and stronger online sales, whereas Target faced a significant earnings miss, cut its forecast, and is reportedly losing market share to competitors like Walmart and Amazon due to its merchandise mix and execution issues. This divergence highlights shifting consumer spending patterns in the current economic climate.

title: Target begins offering Black Friday deals
summary: Target has launched its Black Friday promotion ahead of schedule, offering significant discounts on thousands of items both online and in stores from November 21-30. The retailer will also feature exclusive Taylor Swift merchandise, extended shopping hours, and follow up with a Cyber Monday event. This early start mirrors competitors and aims to provide customers with the lowest prices of the season.

title: Amazon now accepts EBT card payments
summary: Amazon has begun accepting EBT card payments for eligible federal assistance recipients in 17 states and the District of Columbia. This expansion allows needy families to purchase select items like electronics, toys, beauty products, and home goods on Amazon's website. The initiative builds on a previous pilot program with the USDA for SNAP recipients to buy food items online.

title: America eats the world
summary: This article discusses the unprecedented dominance of US equities in the world market, with the S&P 500 now accounting for two-thirds of the world equity index. It explores how this concentration has occurred, driven by the rise of technology and the "Magnificent Seven" tech stocks, and questions whether this momentum is sustainable in the long term, especially considering the shift of these tech giants towards more capital-heavy AI investments. The author uses a "second-level thinking" approach to analyze the drivers and potential challenges to this US market leadership.

title: Under the Hood of Fidelity’s Blue Chip Growth ETF
summary: The Fidelity Blue Chip Growth ETF (FBCG) is an actively managed U.S. equity growth strategy that has significantly outperformed its benchmark, the Russel 1000 Growth index. The fund employs bottom-up fundamental analysis to identify blue chip companies with sustainable business models, high returns on equity, and strong earnings growth, including both mega-cap and emerging companies. FBCG's active management and investment strategy have led to attractive returns for investors.

title: Nasdaq-Listed Acurx Invests $1M in Bitcoin—What’s Behind the Move?
summary: Nasdaq-listed biotech firm Acurx Pharmaceuticals has invested $1 million in Bitcoin, signaling a growing trend of corporate cryptocurrency adoption for treasury management. The company views Bitcoin as a strong reserve asset due to its limited supply, inflation-resistant characteristics, and increasing institutional support, including recent ETF approvals. Despite this financial strategy, Acurx assures investors it will not impact its core drug development plans.

title: Under the Hood of Fidelity’s Blue Chip Growth
summary: The Fidelity Blue Chip Growth ETF (FBCG) is an active U.S. equity growth strategy with a large-cap bias that has outperformed its benchmark, the Russel 1000 Growth index. The fund focuses on identifying blue chip companies with sustainable business models, high returns on equity, and strong revenue and earnings growth through bottom-up fundamental analysis. FBCG's portfolio includes both mega-cap companies and smaller emerging growers, aiming for consistent +10% annual EPS growth.

title: The 2025 Investment Outlook for Financial Advisors
summary: Morningstar's 2025 Investment Outlook for Financial Advisors discusses key investment themes for the coming year, including opportunities outside the US due to high valuations in American stocks, strategies for generating returns in a falling rate environment, and considerations for investing in private assets. The outlook also details the evolving impact of AI on both investment portfolios and financial advisor practices. It aims to help advisors navigate challenges and opportunities for their clients in 2025.

title: Cheese Danishes, cinnamon rolls sold at Walmart recalled over plastic contamination
summary: Over 43,000 Great Value brand cheese Danishes and cinnamon rolls sold at Walmart stores nationwide are being recalled due to potential plastic contamination. The voluntary recall by JM Smucker Company LLC was issued on November 1st and classified as a "Class II" recall by the FDA, indicating possible harmful health impacts. This incident follows other recent recalls, including baby powder for asbestos contamination and apple juice for high arsenic levels.

title: Amazon Investing an Additional $4 Billion in AI Firm Anthropic
summary: Amazon (AMZN) is investing an additional $4 billion in artificial intelligence startup Anthropic, significantly increasing its stake in a major competitor to OpenAI. This new investment follows an earlier $4 billion infusion this year, which included agreements for Anthropic to utilize Amazon Web Services data centers and AWS-designed AI chips. The deal further strengthens the ties between Anthropic and Amazon’s cloud unit, while Anthropic also maintains connections with Alphabet Inc.’s Google.

title: Elastic N.V. (NYSE:ESTC) Q2 2025 Earnings Call Transcript
summary: Elastic N.V. (NYSE:ESTC) reported strong Q2 fiscal 2025 earnings, exceeding revenue and profitability guidance with 18% year-over-year revenue growth and a 25% increase in cloud revenue. The company highlighted significant momentum in generative AI, with new customer commitments nearly doubling and a growing adoption of its vector database for AI applications. Elastic also announced the departure of CFO and COO Janesh Moorjani, with Eric Pringle stepping in as Interim CFO.

title: Data Center Developer Equinix Issues $1.2 Billion of Green Bonds
summary: Equinix, a data center and digital infrastructure company, has issued €1.15 billion (USD$1.21 billion) in green bonds to finance green projects, including renewable energy and decarbonization solutions. This issuance establishes Equinix as a top 5 issuer of green bonds in the U.S. with a total of $6.9 billion to date. The company aims to address increasing energy demand from AI-driven growth while committing to significant GHG emissions reductions and 100% renewable energy by 2030.

title: Special Report: Astoria’s 10 ETFs for 2025
summary: Astoria Portfolio Advisors releases its "10 ETFs for 2025" report, advising investors to prepare for a potential "Trump Put" and a shift in market leadership towards small-caps, mid-caps, cyclicals, and real assets. The report suggests reducing exposure to mega-cap growth stocks, being tactical in fixed income, and considering Ethereum and a basket of cryptocurrencies like BITW given the changing political and economic landscape. It emphasizes buying assets below intrinsic value and being prepared for increased inflation and deficit concerns.

title: Zacks Investment Ideas feature highlights: BWX Technologies, Oklo, Amazon, Vistra and Nvidia
summary: This article from Zacks Investment Ideas features five stocks—BWX Technologies, Oklo, Amazon, Vistra, and Nvidia—highlighting their potential for growth, particularly in the AI and nuclear energy sectors. It discusses the increasing demand for nuclear power to support AI data centers, the U.S. government's push for nuclear energy, and the strong performance and investment potential of the featured companies. The article emphasizes the "buy and hold" strategy for these stocks, citing their financial health, growth projections, and market performance.

title: How to show users in a UNIX group in Netapp, explained
summary: This article explains how to display users in a UNIX group within a NetApp environment, detailing methods for groups managed locally, via LDAP, or integrated with NetApp ONTAP. It covers the use of commands like `getent`, `ldapsearch`, and ONTAP CLI utilities to verify group memberships and troubleshoot related access issues. The piece emphasizes understanding the context of group management for effective data access control.

title: Amazon.com (AMZN) Invests $4B in Anthropic: A Strategic Move to Challenge NVIDIA in AI
summary: Amazon.com (AMZN) has invested $4 billion in AI startup Anthropic, aiming to challenge NVIDIA's dominance in the AI chip market. This strategic move is intended to make Amazon's Neuron SDK more appealing by having Anthropic teams work directly with AWS personnel to facilitate customer transitions from NVIDIA. The article also touches upon the broader adoption of AI in manufacturing and its observed benefits like increased efficiency and productivity.

title: Warner Bros Discovery Sued For Misleading Investors On NBA Before Losing It
summary: Warner Bros. Discovery (WBD) and its executives David Zaslav and Gunnar Wiedenfels have been sued in federal court for allegedly misleading investors about the impact of potentially losing NBA media rights. A shareholder filed a class-action lawsuit claiming WBD made false statements regarding its business prospects between February and August 2024, leading to significant investor losses. This comes after WBD took a massive $9.1 billion write-down related to the loss of NBA on TNT and its stock price fell.

title: Sanofi CEO Paul Hudson takes inspiration from ‘Fight Club’ to get his team hooked on AI
summary: Sanofi CEO Paul Hudson is using unconventional methods, inspired by "Fight Club," to integrate AI throughout the pharmaceutical giant since announcing an "all in on AI" strategy in 2023. This includes a hackathon using the company's plai app, which optimizes supply chain and R&D with LLMs, leading to $800 million in reallocated funds. Hudson emphasizes that exclusivity and organic curiosity fostered by his "Fight Club" approach are key to successful AI adoption in large corporations.

title: Forbes Global CEO conference 2024: Key insights and highlights
summary: The 22nd Forbes Global CEO Conference in Bangkok, Thailand, gathered 400 global leaders to discuss key issues and foster partnerships. Bernard Arnault received the Malcolm S. Forbes Lifetime Achievement Award. Key discussions included Thailand's investment appeal with Prime Minister Paetongtarn Shinawatra, economic theories, market strategies, and adapting business models to new realities.

title: The S&P 500 (SPY) Is Ready for a Sell-Off
summary: The S&P 500 has gained 25% year-to-date, but this growth is largely driven by a small group of "Magnificent 7" stocks, pushing valuations above historical averages. While the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (SPY) is generally recommended for long-term investors due to the market's historical resilience, the current concentration of gains suggests a potential sell-off is due. Despite this, experts advise against shorting the market and suggest that consistently investing in SPY can still lead to long-term gains, as bear markets are typically short-lived and followed by stronger bull markets.

title: How this 19th-century land owner stocks grew nearly 200% in 2024 on AI boom
summary: Texas Pacific Land Corp. (TPL), a 19th-century land owner with significant acreage in the Permian Basin, has seen its stock skyrocket 193% in 2024 due to the AI boom. The company is attracting tech giants like Alphabet and Amazon who are looking to lease land and utilize TPL's cheap natural gas to power energy-intensive data centers. TPL's strategic positioning and vast land holdings make it an unexpected beneficiary of the surging demand for energy and space driven by AI applications.

title: Legacy landowner in West Texas surges on AI boom
summary: Texas Pacific Land Corp. has seen its stock surge 230% this year, pushing its market valuation to $40 billion, largely due to the demand by the AI industry for land in the Permian Basin. The company's land holdings are proving ideal for renewable energy projects, Bitcoin mining, and data centers, leveraging the region's access to cheap natural gas. This growth positions the company as a key "AI-adjacent pick and shovel trade," reflecting the increasing investment in digital infrastructure.

title: Yext, Inc. (YEXT) Positioned for Stronger Growth with Expansion into Social Media and Usage-Based Pricing
summary: Yext, Inc. (YEXT) is poised for stronger growth through its recent acquisition of Hearsay Systems, expansion into social media with "Yext Social," and adoption of usage-based pricing for resellers. These strategic moves aim to accelerate innovation and create long-term value, enhancing Yext's position in the cloud-based digital knowledge management and search solutions market. The company is leveraging AI to drive cloud computing growth and focusing on sustainability within the cloud industry.

title: Gravity Announces Global Release of Tokyo Psychodemic
summary: Gravity has officially launched "Tokyo Psychodemic" globally, excluding Japan, on PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, and Nintendo Switch, with updated language support available on Steam. This 2D cinematic forensic investigation game immerses players in a post-pandemic world where they solve unsolved cases using forensic expertise and teamwork, with multiple endings based on player choices. The gameplay combines scenario exploration with detailed case narratives and evidence collection, including analyzing crime scene data and utilizing live-action CCTV footage to create an engaging and immersive investigative experience.

title: Royal Philips and AWS expand partnership to migrate health systems to the cloud
summary: Royal Philips and Amazon Web Services (AWS) have expanded their partnership to migrate health systems to the cloud, aiming to enhance Philips' integrated diagnostics portfolio, including radiology and digital pathology. The collaboration will leverage AWS's generative AI capabilities to create applications that reduce administrative tasks, such as "conversational reporting." This expansion builds on their existing relationship, which has already seen Philips migrate 150 sites to AWS, with future migrations planned for Europe.

title: SanDisk’s Extreme 1TB microSD Is One Of The Fastest Storage Cards Out There, And It Is Down To $79.99 For Amazon Black Friday 2024
summary: The SanDisk Extreme 1TB microSD card is currently on sale for $79.99 during Amazon's Black Friday 2024 event. This high-speed storage card boasts transfer speeds of up to 190MB/s and write speeds of up to 130MB/s, making it suitable for 4K and 5K video recording. It also includes an SD card adapter and a two-year subscription to RescuePRO Deluxe for file recovery.

title: TSS, Inc. (TSSI) Stock Declines 19% Post-Uplisting Amid Insider Sales, Despite 31% Monthly Gain
summary: TSS, Inc. (TSSI) experienced a 19% stock decline between November 14 and 27, shortly after uplisting to NASDAQ, despite a 31% monthly gain. This decline is attributed to significant insider sales by the company's CEO, SVP, and COO during that period. The company offers integration technology services supporting AI-driven infrastructure and is considered an emerging AI stock.

title: Traeger Black Friday grill deals — these 3 sales all have $200 off
summary: This article highlights three Black Friday deals on Traeger grills, each offering a $200 discount. It focuses on the Traeger Grills Pro 575, the iconic Ironwood 650, and the top-tier Ironwood 885, emphasizing their smart features like app compatibility and precise temperature control. The author explains that buying grills out of season, such as during Black Friday, allows savvy shoppers to save significantly on high-quality pellet smokers.

title: How GE Vernova plans to deploy small nuclear reactors across the developed world
summary: GE Vernova aims to deploy small modular reactors (SMRs) globally, targeting over $2 billion in annual revenue from its SMR business by the mid-2030s. The company sees potential for 57 reactors across the U.S., Canada, Europe, and the U.K. by 2035, driven by surging electricity demand and interest from utilities and major tech companies for AI data centers. Their BWRX-300 SMR is designed to be more affordable and flexible than large nuclear plants, with the first commercial deployment scheduled for 2029 in Canada.

title: 2024 Black Friday and Cyber Monday: Best golf deals and sales updated live
summary: This article compiles a live-updated list of the best Black Friday and Cyber Monday golf deals and sales for 2024. It covers discounts on various golf products, including shoes, apparel, equipment, electronics, bags, and accessories, from numerous retailers and brands. The author also includes exclusive promo codes for GNN readers to save on their purchases.

title: ‘Small caps are going to become more in favor in 2025': VettaFi’s research head doubles down on winning group
summary: VettaFi's Todd Rosenbluth predicts small-cap stocks will gain favor in 2025, driven by recent strong performance, a shift from "Magnificent Seven" stocks, and investors rotating out of money market accounts due to anticipated Federal Reserve interest rate easing. The Russell 2000 recently hit a record high, and Rosenbluth suggests ETFs like the iShares Core S&P Small-Cap ETF and VictoryShares Small Cap Free Cash Flow ETF as ways to capitalize on this trend.
